about.title: About AGRO-MARKS
about.intro: AGRO-MARKS is a platform for discovering Cameroonian producers: farmers and livestock breeders present their farms and the way they work.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.text: To make farmers and livestock breeders, their farms and their production methods visible, so that everyone understands where their food comes from.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.text: Present practices as described by the growers, without unsupported promises.

proximity.title: Proximity
proximity.text: Bring the public closer to the people who grow crops and raise animals, region by region.

quality.title: Quality
quality.text: Highlight the know-how and care that go into both crops and animals.

nature.title: Respect for nature
nature.text: Celebrate the diversity of crops and livestock and the rhythm of the seasons.

status.title: Where is the project today?
status.text: This site is a demo version. Producers and testimonials are fictional. AGRO-MARKS does not sell any products: the platform presents producers. Next steps include onboarding real farms and a process for verifying information.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Answers to the most common questions about AGRO-MARKS and this demo version.

what.question: What is AGRO-MARKS?
what.answer: AGRO-MARKS is a discovery platform that presents Cameroonian farmers and livestock breeders, their farms, their production methods and what they produce.

order.question: Can I buy products or pay online?
order.answer: No. AGRO-MARKS is not an online shop: no ordering, payment or delivery is offered on the platform.

producerTypes.question: What kinds of producers are featured?
producerTypes.answer: The platform features farmers, who grow crops, and livestock breeders, who raise poultry, cattle, pigs, goats, sheep, fish or bees. Other types of producers may be added later.

farmers.question: Do the producers shown really exist?
farmers.answer: The farms and people shown are fictional. They are inspired by production that genuinely takes place in Cameroon's regions.

certification.question: Are the production practices certified?
certification.answer: No. The practices described are presented as reported by the producers. No certification, label or health guarantee is claimed in this version.

favorites.question: How do favourites work?
favorites.answer: Favourites are saved in your browser's local storage. They are not linked to an account and disappear if you clear the site's data.

join.question: I am a farmer or livestock breeder. How can I join the platform?
join.answer: Producer registration is not open yet. You can express your interest through the contact page; note that messages are not transmitted yet in this version.

languages.question: Which languages is the site available in?
languages.answer: The site is available in French and English. Use the language selector in the header to switch between them.
